GenRec's average treatment effect on the short-term homepage engagement metric was **+0.115%** relative to the production model, with a **p-value of 3.1 × 10⁻¹⁰**. Figure 3 marks this result as statistically significant (page 1).

The test ran on about 10% of Netflix traffic for 4 weeks. It compared GenRec with the production baseline, which the figure shows as the reference at 0 (page 1).
